author: Daisy Rathi
text:
We went through this same transition with my son  Dexcom G6 is being discontinued mid-2026, and everyone’s trying to figure out what works next. 
HomeCare Magazine

With the FreeStyle Libre 3, yes there is a follow/share feature. You use the Libre 3 app on the wearer’s phone, and then the LibreLinkUp app to invite family/caregivers. Once connected, they can see real-time glucose readings and alarms on their own devices, which helps with remote monitoring at school or when you’re not there. 
pro.freestyle.abbott
+1

One thing we found practical, especially with school and overnight changes, is having true continuous monitoring with alerts, rather than relying on occasional scans or back-filled data. That’s why we use NightRider BluCon (or the waterproof version like Waterproof NightRider BluCon)  it turns a Libre sensor into a real-time CGM with readings every ~5 min and lets us share data on phones/watches. You can set custom alarms for highs/lows and keep an eye on trends without constantly scanning or waiting for uploads. 
Ambrosia Glucose Monitoring
+1
It doesn’t “fix” diabetes, but it does make follow/share and trend awareness so much more usable when your kid is at school or asleep.
